svg.title: Scorsonère — Scorzonera hispanica
svg.desc: Black salsify, a lifted specimen with a very long slender black-brown taproot and fine lateral rootlets. Smooth narrow lance-shaped leaves rise from its crown. An airy branching stalk bears one pale ochre-yellow head of toothed strap-shaped florets, and a closed pointed flower bud. Fine curved engraving strokes follow the bark, leaf veins and flower bracts.
